title: Gold Springs Park Campground

services.name: Gold Springs Park Campground
services.desc: Located 10 km. north of the Canada/U.S. border this beautiful, well cared for campground has 70 sites, most with power, rental cabins, showers, playground, 2 water slides, firewood, stage, kitchens, volleyball net, paddle boats, fishing in the reservoir and canoe access to the Milk River.
